name: LoveOne
source:
Upon the sudden appearance of an angel, Yi Seung-Ho (the protagonist) wished for love. But the self-proclaimed angel is not being as helpful as he had hoped and his relationships continue to take unexpected twists and turns. 

Although achieving a happy love life remains the protagonist's main focus, the story takes our protagonist to the seas and to the mountains...
translation:
天使突然出现，李承浩（主角）渴望爱情。但这位自称天使的人并没有像他希望的那样乐于助人，他的人际关系继续出现意想不到的曲折。

尽管实现幸福的爱情生活仍然是主角的主要关注点，但故事将我们的主角带到了大海和山上……
